title: Creatures round 4: three new versions of PB7, YE10 and YE11
desc: J rated v2.0117 IMPROVE with no note on PB7 (lean sloth rear-up), YE10 (bold fold teleport) and YE11 (fear-cracked shell), so each gets three siblings built differently. The bears also carry his notes from the same rating: a fuller face and the front paws turned in with big anteater claws. Minecraft ticks (20 a second), IK feet, every frame checked.

takes.name: PB7 lean sloth, version a: rear-up and slam
takes.facts: PB7's lean sloth bear (longest arms, v2.0116 fur) rears up slowly, roars with its arms spread, then slams both front paws down fast on tick 43: a hard squash and a big burst of snow dust. With J's bear notes: a fuller face and the front paws turned in with big anteater claws

takes.name: PB7 lean sloth, version b: rear-up and sway
takes.facts: rears up and stays tall, swaying side to side with its long arms hanging loose in front and the claws dangling, like a sloth bear sizing you up, then drops heavily onto its front paws. Fuller face, inward anteater claws

takes.name: PB7 lean sloth, version c: rear-up claw display
takes.facts: rears up with both arms raised high over its head, claws spread, and rakes the air twice toward you (ticks 27 and 37) before dropping back down with a thud. Fuller face, inward anteater claws

takes.name: YE10 fold teleport, version a: jagged crack of light
takes.facts: YE10's fold teleport with the seam drawn as a jagged zigzag crack of yellow light as tall as the enderman: it glitches, folds into the crack, the crack snaps shut, tears open 3 blocks away and unfolds it

takes.name: YE10 fold teleport, version b: folds flat into a pool of light
takes.facts: instead of folding into a line it squashes flat down into a glowing yellow pool on the ground, the pool closes, opens 3 blocks away and it rises back up out of it

takes.name: YE10 fold teleport, version c: seam opens like a door
takes.facts: two glowing yellow bars stand up and part like a doorway, it folds into the gap, the bars close; at the new spot the doorway opens again and it unfolds out between them

takes.name: YE11 fear-cracked shell, version a: shattered
takes.facts: black skin crazed with a web of thin yellow cracks like shattered glass (real cell shapes, not dashes); slams its lantern into the ground on tick 22, a shockwave ring runs out

takes.name: YE11 fear-cracked shell, version b: lightning veins that flare
takes.facts: yellow lightning veins run down its arms, legs and body; they glow dim, then flare bright for a moment when the lantern hits the ground on tick 22

takes.name: YE11 fear-cracked shell, version c: big cracks and ground fissures
takes.facts: a few big cracks across the black shell; the slam makes them flare and seven glowing fissures split across the ground from where the lantern hits, then fade
